posts.title: Tips?
posts.text: Curious how other owners handle tips. About half of my irrigation clients have been tipping for service calls, and I’m wondering how common that is for others. I use Yardbook, which has a built-in tip option for customers when they pay. I’m not actively asking for tips, but the option is there. For context, this is just for my irrigation business, not the lawn maintenance side. How do you handle tipping as an owner? Do you leave the option available, or prefer not to encourage it?
posts.author: JFGLN

posts.title: Do you guys ask for Google reviews?
posts.text: When you finish a job, do you ask the customer for a Google review, or just let them come in on their own? Curious how most of you handle it.

posts.title: Solo guys, how much of your day is drive time?
posts.text: Curious how other solo and small crews handle this. When I talk to guys running one or two trucks, the thing that comes up most isn't mowing time, it's the driving in between. A route that looks fine on paper ends up with one stop across town that eats half an hour. How do you build your routes? Do you group by zip or neighborhood, use an app, or just know your area well enough to wing it? And roughly what percent of your day would you say is windshield time? Also, if you've ever turned... Solo guys, how much of your day is drive time?
